# Attribution

New short-control-width accounting, additive phase stream, fixed-tape argument
and exact controls: chafreaky with OpenAI Codex assistance, 2026-10-11.

The chirp array, permuted Fourier identity, padded-box size bands and retained
scalar exponential interface come from the integer-mult-bounds manuscript,
including Douglas Colkitt and its credited contributors. The exponential and
short-integer multiplication interfaces remain the manuscript's cited Harvey
and van der Hoeven algorithms; this package does not reimplement them.

The unchanged outer arithmetic is credited in its source to eumemic,
icekylinx and Zhihao Chen. SOURCE.json pins every reused file. Original files
and licenses are retained. Elementary quadratic finite differences are not
claimed as a new mathematical identity. Apache-2.0.
